autoWorkflow: Validate the local plan and all protected production variants.
Select the first unfinished entry in plan order.
If its original locale is missing, submit exactly that one locale as UTILITY and stop.
If Meta review is pending, make no mutation and stop.
If the original locale is APPROVED/UTILITY with exact components, delete only its matching proof and stop.
On the next invocation, resume with the next unfinished entry.
Finish only when all four original locales are APPROVED/UTILITY and all four proofs are absent.

components.text: Bonjour {{1}}, il reste environ {{2}} minutes à votre Assistant IA Clinket ce mois-ci. Vous pouvez consulter votre solde et, au besoin, ajouter des minutes dans votre tableau de bord Clinket.

englishReference.body: Hi {{1}}, your Clinket AI Assistant has about {{2}} minutes left this month. Top up on your Clinket dashboard anytime to keep it answering your calls without interruption.

entries.closenessDecision: Preserves the monthly remaining-minute notice, AI Assistant, dashboard, and optional addition of minutes. It omits only the interruption-prevention sales framing that caused classification risk.

entries.closenessDecision: Preserves the monthly remaining-minute notice, AI Assistant, dashboard, and optional addition of minutes. It omits only the interruption-prevention sales framing that caused classification risk.

components.text: Hola, {{1}}. {{2}} solicita tu autorización para iniciar una conversación contigo por WhatsApp desde Clinket acerca de un servicio. Responde *YES* para autorizar esta conversación o *STOP* para rechazarla y dejar de recibir mensajes de Clinket por WhatsApp.
Solicitud de contacto de un proveedor de Clinket.

englishReference.body: Hi {{1}}, this is {{2}} on Clinket. You can chat with us right here on WhatsApp about your service. Reply *YES* to continue, or *STOP* to opt out at any time.
englishReference.footer: From a Clinket provider you contacted.

entries.closenessDecision: Preserves the provider identity, service-related WhatsApp conversation, YES authorization, and STOP opt-out. It replaces the English contact assumption with truthful provider-initiated authorization because the CRM trigger does not prove that the customer previously contacted the provider.

components.text: Actualización de tu cuenta, {{1}}: finalizó la prueba gratuita del plan Clinket {{2}}. Como no se registró ningún método de pago, tu cuenta pasó automáticamente al plan gratuito. Tu cuenta y tus datos siguen disponibles. Puedes administrar el método de pago y el plan {{2}} desde el panel de Clinket.

englishReference.body: Hi {{1}}, your free trial of Clinket {{2}} has ended. Since no payment method was added, you've moved to the free Clinket plan, and everything in your account stays exactly as it is. Add a payment method to get {{2}} back anytime.

entries.closenessDecision: Preserves trial completion, missing payment method, automatic free-plan move, account and data continuity, and billing management. It removes only the direct plan-recovery promotion while retaining the operational billing path.
